user_id.description: ID of the user that owns the key

key_display.description: Truncated form of the key, safe to display. The key itself is only ever returned once, at creation.

time_last_used.description: When the key was last presented on a request, or null if never used

time_revoked.description: When the key was revoked, or null if the key is still active

ApiKey.description: API key metadata. Never includes the key itself. Demo limitation: keys are currently held in server memory and do not survive a server restart.

name.description: Label used to identify the key later

key.description: The API key itself. Returned only in this response and never recoverable afterwards; store it now.
